label: GO step choosing a2 in the last ~8 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass) and only in the last trials of the episode: 99.7% of mass is at ep_trial 90-99, none before trial 80. All of its activations fall in the lowest value-head bin (value < 5.22, which tracks how little episode is left), and 98.6% are on GO steps where the agent picks a2 (choice logit strongly negative); it is almost silent when the agent picks a1. Inside the window, activation grows over consecutive late trials. A previous reward (prev_reward==1) raises it, which is why trials 92-94 need prev_reward==1 while from trial 95 on it fires whether or not the last trial was rewarded. It never fires at D1 or D2, and it does not depend on the transition type or on the reward the agent is about to get. The simpler (phase==GO)&(ep_trial>=92)&(model_act==2) gets dev F1 0.75; the refined predicate gets dev F1 0.80, mass recall 0.95. Test precision is only about 0.69: many late a2 GO steps stay below threshold, and its onset seems to be a soft threshold on the episode clock/value. It uses only the agent's own choice and the episode time, which is observable (no future outcomes). Best read as an end-of-episode, choose-a2 unit: a candidate-low coordinate that tracks the episode clock and is gated on the a2 choice.
